text: my image is still offset, do i need to add it back again or something or
resolution: Resolved: the 'image still offset' was NOT the camera-persistence fix — the camera/selection working-view restore (f03e5c74b) works. The backdrop itself was stale and just needed re-adding; once the user re-added the reference image it persisted correctly across reloads. No code change required for this one; diagnosis only.
